title: Variance lower bound for a truncated Rademacher sum
statement: For every positive integer $n$, let $X$ be uniform on $\{-1,1\}^n$ and set $S_n(X)=n^{-1/2}\sum_{i=1}^n X_i$. The variance of $S_n(X)$ after truncating its value to the interval $[-1,1]$ is at least $1/24$.
